'''Gareth Agamar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[TIE pilot]] in service to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Agamar was born on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] into a [[Agamar family|family]] with a long history of military service. Agamar's parents had both served as [[Officer/Legends|officers]] in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Galactic Republic Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and his siblings all served in the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]].<ref name="Strongholds" />

Agamar himself was drawn to spaceflight at a young age and joined the [[Imperial Naval Academy/Legends|Imperial Naval Academy]] to pursue a career as a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]]. He graduated top of his class and went on to achieve the rank of [[Lieutenant Commander/Legends|lieutenant commander]], serving in several positions in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]], including a lengthy assignment as commander of the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Mercurial]]''{{'s}} starfighter contingent, before being given command of the [[481st Experimental Starfighter Testing Squadron]]. Under his command, the 481st was tasked with testing the [[TIE/ph "Phantom" Multi-Role Stealth Starfighter/Legends|TIE/ph phantom]], a new starfighter fitted with an experimental [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking device]].<ref name="Strongholds" />
